seo.title: Privacy Policy - Acumen
seo.description: How Acumen collects, uses and protects personal data on acumen.be.

html:
Privacy Policy

Who we are

This website (www.acumen.be) is run by Acumen Consulting BV, Ambachtenlaan 14 bus 8, 3001 Heverlee (Leuven), Belgium, VAT BE 0891.078.523 (“Acumen”, “we”). Acumen is the controller of the personal data described below. For any question about your data, write to info@acumen.be.

What we collect and why

Contact form. Your name, company, e-mail address, phone number and message, so we can answer your question. Basis: our legitimate interest in replying to you, or steps you ask us to take before a possible agreement.

Whitepaper and newsletter forms. Your name, e-mail address and, if you give it, your company, so we can send you the whitepaper and, as the form states, our marketing e-mails. Basis: your consent. You can unsubscribe at any time.

Job applications. Your first and last name, e-mail address and the CV you upload, to assess your application. Basis: steps you ask us to take before a possible employment contract. If we do not hire you, we delete your application unless you agree that we keep it for future vacancies.

Form submissions are sent from the website to Acumen’s internal systems and are only used by Acumen staff involved in answering you, sending you what you asked for or handling your application.

Cookies and similar technologies

When you first visit, a banner lets you choose which cookies you accept. Your choice is stored in the cookieyes-consent cookie in your browser for 365 days. You can change it at any time through the cookie icon at the bottom of every page; withdrawing a choice stops the related tool.

  • Necessary: the consent cookie itself. Always on.
  • Analytics: Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager (Google Ireland Ltd.), to see how the site is used. Only loaded after you accept; until then Google Consent Mode is set to “denied”.
  • Advertisement: the LinkedIn Insight Tag (LinkedIn Ireland Unlimited Company), to measure our LinkedIn campaigns. Only loaded after you accept.

Google and LinkedIn may process data outside the European Economic Area; they do so under the EU–US Data Privacy Framework or the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses.

Hosting

The website is hosted by Vercel Inc. When you visit it, the host processes technical data such as your IP address and the pages you request, to deliver the site and keep it secure.

How long we keep your data

We keep personal data no longer than needed for the purpose it was collected for, and afterwards only as long as the law requires us to.

Your rights

You have the right to access, correct and delete your data, to restrict or object to its processing, to data portability and to withdraw your consent at any time. Send your request to info@acumen.be. You can also lodge a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority (Gegevensbeschermingsautoriteit), www.dataprotectionauthority.be.

Last updated: 29 September 2026.
